context: Horizontal waterfall chart showing per-criterion score deltas after inter-rater calibration, with 12 criteria bars plus a net change bar, using a 3-color Tol palette (blue/gain, red/loss, green/net)
first_impression: Clean and scannable — the waterfall structure is immediately legible and the restrained 3-color palette keeps the eye moving without distraction.
what_works: The 3-color CVD-safe palette is minimal and sufficient; value labels placed outside bars in matching colors make reading individual deltas effortless without cluttering bar interiors. The dashed separator and bolded green label for the net change row create clear visual hierarchy between the incremental steps and the summary.
what_doesnt: Several annotation leader lines are geometrically awkward — the elbow paths terminate at fixed offsets regardless of bar position, causing some labels (e.g. 'Leader line overlap penalty' on Annotation placement, 'Lie factor recalibrated' on Encoding honesty) to land close to adjacent bar edges or crowd the right margin. The connector lines showing cumulative flow between bars are very faint (0.8px dashed gray) and may be missed entirely, weakening the core waterfall storytelling.
